notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Great Whale
When Donnie & April and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
